revisions.summary: Initial Crawlee package: manifest, PlaywrightCrawler runner, sitemap discovery, embedded product JSON + JSON-LD extraction, HTML cleaner, 22-column CSV export, diagnostics and contract tests.

Smoke-run fixes: registered the pre-navigation hook via PlaywrightCrawler.pre_navigation_hook (Crawlee 1.11.2 does not accept it as a constructor kwarg), and made embedded variant prices authoritative so an all-zero variant set cannot fall back to a JSON-LD offer.
revisions.verified_by: diagnostics/smoke-001 (temp run): 1 valid product, 3 top-level requests, 0 failures

revisions.summary: Post-run selector fix: the description selector matched an empty .product__description.rte placeholder on two products and recorded it as a DOM-captured description. The fix requires non-empty text, uses .product__description.rte first, distinguishes an empty source container (not_provided) from a missing container (failed), and records selector/empty-container evidence. Added 3 contract tests (16 total).

smoke_run.note: Integration smoke test only; not the bounded trial.

build_errors: Plain HTTP probes (curl, including a proxy bypass) returned 429 local_rate_limited with retry-after: 60 for product and collection pages; a real Chromium page returned 200 for the same product page. These probes are not part of the measured run.
network_note: HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY/NO_PROXY are present. The browser used the platform's default network path; the actual egress was not independently measured. No credentials are recorded.
